title: Run full GF(p) FieldMatrix fflas-comparable benchmark sweep
description:
Run the deferred full `fieldmatrix_gemm` reference benchmark sweep for the GF(p) delayed-reduction work from `e7ab802d`.

## Background

`e7ab802d` implemented delayed product-sum reductions for `FieldMatrix::gemm` over prime fields and recorded fast-budget 64x64x64 cells in `dev/benchmarks/e7ab802d-fieldmatrix-gemm-delayed.md`. The original aspirational target involved n>=256 comparison against fflas-ffpack, but that sweep is too slow/reference-host-dependent for the normal agent fast tier and was explicitly deferred.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Run the existing full `fieldmatrix_gemm`/reference comparison path for the GF(p) cells relevant to `64c88ae4`, including at least one n>=256 square cell and any rectangular cells that fit the reference-host budget.
- [hard] Record commands, host/toolchain, matrix shapes, fields, gf2 throughput, reference fflas-ffpack throughput where available, and ratios in a committed evidence document.
- [hard] Clearly mark cells deferred to nightly/slow infrastructure if they exceed the reference-host budget, with the reason.
- [hard] Compare the measured post-`e7ab802d` numbers against the `64c88ae4` published gf2-side baseline and state whether the within-10x aspirational target is met for any n>=256 cell.
- [hard] No implementation changes are required unless the benchmark harness is broken; any code changes must pass `cargo-ci` and `code-review`.

## Notes

This is a benchmarking/evidence task, not normal fast-tier implementation work. Do not run slow/ignored tests as part of routine agent validation. Use the reference host or slow/nightly lane appropriate for fflas-comparable benchmarking.
